messages:
tanya_sales: Quick thread — IonWave (partner) asking for a joint co-sell POC. They want Redwood Dedicated in their AWS account (VPC peering), SSO (SAML), CMK/HSM, per-tenant telemetry, and a pricing sketch for bursty traffic. Can we do a short tech handoff + call tomorrow? cc @olga_partner

olga_partner: Thanks Tanya. Requirements: data must remain in our VPC, EU region (Frankfurt) primary, p90 latency target <=150ms, typical ctx ~512 tokens with rare 2k spikes. Need audit logs and per-route telemetry for compliance. Also want a quick note on provisioning lead time.

devin_se: I can run presales. Two clarifiers: expected sustained qps vs burst concurrency? are warmers acceptable? My proposal: (1) sandbox: 1 small GPU + hosted fallback, (2) pilot: 3 reserved GPUs, tenant KV cache, canary deploy. Deliverables: ASCII topology, SAML flow, egress/ip whitelist plan, k6/curl load snippet, security Q responses.

tanya_sales: They said sustained ~20 qps, burst ~150-220 concurrent (first month). Warmers OK, p90 goal <150ms. Provisioning lead time tolerated ~10 business days.

devin_se: Great. Quick topology: Partner VPC <-> VPC peering -> Redwood Dedicated subnet -> regional gateway -> tenant routing to dedicated pool; fallback to hosted variants with circuit-breaker. I'll draft ASCII diagram and attach a tiny k6 curl snippet.

devin_se: Load test example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","input":"Summarize this","max_tokens":256}'
```

priet_eng: Pricing/ops note: propose a 3-month pilot: baseline reserve (50% commit) + burst credits billed at usage with partner discount 20% for Q1. Provisioning lead time for dedicated pool ~8-10 business days; hosted fallback available for immediate testing. Telemetry: we can export aggregated token metrics and per-tenant latency histograms (no raw PII). We'll provide schema + sampling guidance.

olga_partner: Security Qs: they sent a vendor questionnaire. Need SOC2 mapping, confirmation of CMK/HSM, and network egress diagram showing audit log flow.

security-bot: Confirmed: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported for Private/Dedicated deployments. SOC2 pack link: https://s3.redwood.example/soc2-pack.pdf. Eng-security will review vendor questionnaire and respond within 48h.

tanya_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 09:30 PT — confirm? 2) Devin: topology + load harness by EOD. 3) Priet: pricing sketch + telemetry doc by EOD. 4) Olga: confirm CIDR, SSO contact, and telemetry endpoint.

calendar-bot: Event created: "IonWave joint POC kickoff" 2026-04-02 09:30 PT. Invites: tanya_sales, devin_se, priet_eng, olga_partner, security-bot.

tanya_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll turn this into a 1-page runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
